estilo: Children's picture book illustration, soft watercolor and colored pencil textures, warm gentle colors, clean friendly shapes, expressive cute characters, correct anatomy, vertical composition, no text, no letters.

chapeu.descricao: Little Red Riding Hood, a cheerful 7-year-old girl with rosy cheeks, big brown eyes and short wavy chestnut hair, wearing a bright red hooded cape over a white blouse and a blue skirt

mae.descricao: the girl's mother, a kind ADULT woman about 30 years old, tall and slender with adult body proportions, clearly a grown-up much taller than a 7-year-old child, chestnut hair in a low bun, green dress and cream apron

vovo.descricao: a sweet elderly grandmother with white hair, round glasses, a white lace nightcap and a pink shawl

lobo.descricao: the Big Bad Wolf, a tall anthropomorphic grey wolf standing on two legs, bushy tail, yellow eyes, sly toothy grin, wearing a patched brown vest, exactly ONE tail

lobo_disf.descricao: the SAME tall grey wolf from the reference image (same face, yellow eyes and sly grin, exactly one tail) now disguised as grandma, wearing her white lace nightcap, round glasses and a pink flowered nightgown

cacador.descricao: a friendly bearded woodsman with a green hat with a feather, brown jacket and red checkered shirt, carrying a lantern

casa.descricao: a charming cottage with a red door and flower boxes at the edge of a village, sunny morning, empty scene with no people and no animals

bosque.descricao: a sunny meadow path full of colorful wildflowers and butterflies, empty scene with no people and no animals

floresta.descricao: a dense green forest with tall trees and a winding dirt path, soft dappled light, empty scene with no people and no animals

casa_vovo.descricao: grandma's small stone cottage in a forest clearing, wooden door, smoke from the chimney, empty scene with no people and no animals

quarto_vovo.descricao: grandma's cozy bedroom with a wooden bed and patchwork quilt, a big wardrobe, lace curtains, empty scene with no people and no animals
